psyduck-brine.name: Brine
psyduck-brine.description: Bond skill: a jet of salty water at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 90).

psyduck-aqua-jet.name: Aqua Jet
psyduck-aqua-jet.description: Bond skill: a swift jet of water slams a foe (Power 55, Attack).

psyduck-aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
psyduck-aqua-ring.description: Bond skill: a veil of water heals it for 30 HP.

psyduck-headache.name: Headache
psyduck-headache.description: Its headache flares up: deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

psyduck-slippery-feathers.name: Slippery Feathers
psyduck-slippery-feathers.description: Slips away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

psyduck-fury-swipes.name: Fury Swipes
psyduck-fury-swipes.description: New skill: a flurry of quick scratches (Power 45).

psyduck-unlocked-mind.name: Unlocked Mind
psyduck-unlocked-mind.description: Its Psychic-type moves deal 20% more damage.

psyduck-aqua-tail.name: Aqua Tail
psyduck-aqua-tail.description: New skill: swings its tail like a wave at an adjacent foe (Power 70).

psyduck-scald.name: Scald
psyduck-scald.description: New skill: boiling water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 65), Burning it for 2 turns.

psyduck-steady-swimmer.name: Steady Swimmer
psyduck-steady-swimmer.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP.

psyduck-mind-reader.name: Mind Reader
psyduck-mind-reader.description: Knocking out a foe resets its skill cooldowns.

psyduck-whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
psyduck-whirlpool.description: New skill: a whirlpool traps a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 75), Slowing it for 2 turns.

psyduck-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
psyduck-double-edge.description: New skill: a reckless full-body charge at an adjacent foe (Power 85).

psyduck-streamline.name: Streamline
psyduck-streamline.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

psyduck-mental-shield.name: Mental Shield
psyduck-mental-shield.description: Its psychic power deflects blows: takes 10% less damage.

psyduck-muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
psyduck-muddy-water.description: New skill: a muddy flood hits all foes within 2 hexes (Power 80).

psyduck-waterfall.name: Waterfall
psyduck-waterfall.description: New skill: charges with the force of a waterfall (Power 95), knocking the foe 1 hex back.

psyduck-cruel-insight.name: Cruel Insight
psyduck-cruel-insight.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes with any status.

psyduck-team-splash.name: Team Splash
psyduck-team-splash.description: Gives the team 1 Bond whenever it lands a combo.

psyduck-golden-mind.name: Golden Mind
psyduck-golden-mind.description: Capstone. Its headache peaks: its Psychic and Water moves deal 25% more below half HP.

psyduck-golduck-grace.name: Golduck's Grace
psyduck-golduck-grace.description: Capstone. A graceful swimmer: cannot be Slowed or Frozen; heals 15% of max HP per knockout.

psyduck-cloud-nine.name: Cloud Nine
psyduck-cloud-nine.description: Its blank mind lets go: sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

psyduck-disable.name: Disable
psyduck-disable.description: New skill: a dazed stare seals a foe's skills up to 2 hexes away for 1 turn (Disabled).
